record.name: MrScraper
record.one_liner: An AI-powered web scraping and data extraction platform with built-in proxies and browser rendering.
record.access_note: Users can sign up on the platform and generate API tokens directly from their dashboard.
record.api_note: The API covers web page scraping, structured data extraction, scraper management, and account usage.

evidence.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints.
API tokens are managed directly from your MrScraper dashboard.
Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies
The MrScraper MCP server source code is available on GitHub for local setup
